description: "STOP AND CHECK AUTHORIZATION OR NECESSITY: Use this skill whenever considering tools, searches, commands, mutations, research, additional evidence, or operational next steps, or whenever reasoning or output says an action is required, necessary, optional, blocking, authorized, permitted, recommended, executable, or should be performed."

# GEAC X1 — Engineering Authority and Action

## COMPONENT_ID
`AUTHORITY_ACTION`

## ROLE
Decide whether an additional operation is required for the active task and separately whether it is permitted; prevent usefulness from becoming necessity or permission.

## ACTIVATES_WHEN
Reasoning considers research, file/tool access, tests, commands, mutation, deployment, acquisition, execution, or recommendation.

## REQUIRES
Active task object, current answerability/blocking-gap state, exact candidate operation, scope, authority basis, prerequisites, and stop conditions.

## CONSUMES
Task state, evidence gaps, criterion/transition states, explicit user/governing authority, operation scope.

## PRODUCES
`TASK_ANSWERABLE`, blocking gap, operation-required state, permission state, candidate operation, recommendation, execution/no-execution decision.

## CONSTRAINS
Ask in order: answerable now? exact blocking gap? would operation resolve it? required for active task? permitted? prerequisites/stops satisfied? execute or recommend only?

## MAY_ACTIVATE
Evidence/source, transitions, testing, criteria, history, reporting.

## PROHIBITED_TRANSITIONS
`USEFUL(A) -/-> NECESSARY_FOR_ACTIVE_TASK(A)`  
`RELEVANT(E,P) -/-> NECESSARY_FOR_ACTIVE_TASK(acquire(E))`  
`AUTHORIZED(A) -/-> NECESSARY_FOR_ACTIVE_TASK(A)`  
`NECESSARY_FOR_ACTIVE_TASK(A) -/-> AUTHORIZED(A)`  
`RECOMMEND(A) -/-> EXECUTE(A)`

Read-only, reversible, harmless, technically accessible, conventional, confidence-increasing, or interesting does not itself make an operation required or permitted.

If the task is already answerable, do not acquire optional information merely for extra confidence/detail unless the user separately asks for that acquisition.

## FALLBACK
Required but unpermitted -> do not execute; preserve blocking gap. Permitted but unnecessary -> do not execute. Failed prerequisite/stop -> stop dependent operation branch. Recommendation-only task -> recommend, do not execute.

## HANDOFF
Return operation decision and its basis/scope to kernel/reporting. New evidence from a permitted required operation returns to evidence/source classification.

## REENTRY
Re-enter when task objective, blocking gap, permission, prerequisites, or operation result changes.

## SEMANTIC_OWNER
Canonical owner of `AUTHORIZED`, task answerability, active-task necessity, blocking gaps, recommendation/execution separation, and operational permission state.

# GEAC X1 — Engineering Criteria and Status

## COMPONENT_ID
`CRITERIA_STATUS`

## ROLE
Separate empirical properties from the criteria that map them into operational statuses, requirements, pass/fail, or completion.

## ACTIVATES_WHEN
The task asks or asserts readiness, safety, releaseability, pass/fail, correctness, completeness, mandatory requirements, blockers, or another criterion-dependent status.

## REQUIRES
Criterion content plus source, applicability to exact object/scope/version/time, and established properties to evaluate.

## CONSUMES
Criterion representations, authority/applicability relations, established evidence/properties.

## PRODUCES
Applicable-criterion state, criterion-not-established/failed state, and bounded criterion-dependent status.

## CONSTRAINS
Topic relevance is not criterion applicability. Empirical properties do not define a policy. Unsourced adjectives must not create hidden requirements.

## MAY_ACTIVATE
Evidence/source, transitions, testing, authority, reporting.

## PROHIBITED_TRANSITIONS
`CRITERION_NOT_ESTABLISHED(C) != CRITERION_FAILED(C)`  
`PROPERTY(P) -/-> READY` without an applicable readiness criterion.  
`PASS(test_or_criterion) -/-> CORRECT(system)`  
`COMPLETE(X,dimension_1) -/-> COMPLETE(X,dimension_2)`

If no applicable readiness criterion exists, readiness is `NOT_ESTABLISHED`, not `FAIL` and not an invitation to invent requirements.

Words such as critical, mandatory, required, blocking, essential, release-gating, necessary-for-readiness, or sufficient-for-readiness need an identified governing basis.

## FALLBACK
Preserve established properties and return the requested criterion-dependent state as `NOT_ESTABLISHED` when criterion/applicability is missing.

## HANDOFF
Send bounded criterion/status state to the kernel, authority/action when decisions depend on it, and reporting.

## REENTRY
Re-enter when criterion content, applicability, object version/time, or evaluated evidence changes.

## SEMANTIC_OWNER
Canonical owner of `READY`, `SAFE`, `PASS`, `FAIL`, `CORRECT`, `COMPLETE`, criterion applicability, and criterion-dependent requirement semantics.

# GEAC X1 — Engineering Evidence

## COMPONENT_ID
`EVIDENCE_SOURCE`

## ROLE
Classify factual inputs without upgrading how they were acquired or what they establish.

## ACTIVATES_WHEN
Factual information enters reasoning; a prompt/source/log/report/artifact is used; source provenance matters; or the task restricts admissible information.

## REQUIRES
Exact task object and evidence boundary from the X1 kernel.

## CONSUMES
Raw information items, source relations, scope/time/object bounds.

## PRODUCES
`EVIDENCE_ITEM`, acquisition/source relation, admissibility state, and bounded unknown/absence states for downstream components.

## CONSTRAINS
No factual premise enters a material transition without classification. Preserve nested relations such as `SUPPLIED(REPORTS(scan,P))` rather than collapsing them into `P`.

## MAY_ACTIVATE
`required-gate-claim-inference-and-strengthening`, `required-gate-test-scan-results-and-verification`, `required-gate-artifact-identity-and-provenance`, `required-gate-historical-evidence-preservation`.

## PROHIBITED_TRANSITIONS
`SUPPLIED(P) -/-> OBSERVED_OBJECT(P)`  
`SUPPLIED(P) -/-> VERIFIED(P)`  
`REPORTS(S,P) -/-> ESTABLISHED(P)`  
`ASSERTS(S,P) -/-> ESTABLISHED(P)`  
`ATTESTS(S,P) -/-> ESTABLISHED(P)`  
`NOT_SUPPLIED(X) -/-> NOT_PERFORMED(X)`  
`NOT_SUPPLIED(X) -/-> FALSE(X)`  
`UNKNOWN(X) -/-> ABSENT(X)`

A source label such as `STATUS_ASSERTION("VERIFIED",P)` remains a source assertion unless the verification owner separately admits the state.

Closed boundary: outside technical/common/tool facts do not become case premises merely because they are plausible or well known.

## FALLBACK
If source, observation object, acquisition relation, provenance, or scope needed for stronger meaning is missing: preserve the current source relation and mark the missing field `UNKNOWN` when material.

## HANDOFF
Provide classified evidence and exact source/acquisition semantics to the transition owner and any active domain owner.

## REENTRY
Re-enter when new information is acquired or when a changed evidence boundary alters admissibility. Reclassify only affected items.

## SEMANTIC_OWNER
Canonical owner of `SUPPLIED`, `NOT_SUPPLIED`, `ACQUIRED`, `REPORTS`, `ASSERTS`, `ATTESTS`, `STATUS_ASSERTION`, `OBSERVED_REPRESENTATION`, `OBSERVED_OBJECT`, evidence admissibility, and source/acquisition semantics.

# GEAC X1 — Engineering History and Contradictions

## COMPONENT_ID
`HISTORY_CONTRADICTION`

## ROLE
Maintain append-only meaning across time: later evidence may change current conclusions but must not silently rewrite prior states or convert remediation into historical cause.

## ACTIVATES_WHEN
A failure is followed by success, evidence changes, contradiction appears, remediation occurs, a record is reconstructed, or current and prior states differ.

## REQUIRES
Time-bound evidence/claim states and the basis available at each relevant time.

## CONSUMES
Historical/current claim states, contradictions, remediation evidence, reconstructed representations.

## PRODUCES
`HISTORICAL_STATE`, unresolved/resolved contradiction state, remediation state, reconstruction classification.

## CONSTRAINS
Preserve earlier failure, invalid test, unsupported claim, crossed stop condition, or unauthorized action even after later improvement. Resolution requires evidence that discriminates the conflict for a specified proposition/purpose.

## MAY_ACTIVATE
Evidence/source, transitions, identity/time, authority, reporting.

## PROHIBITED_TRANSITIONS
`TRUE_NOW(P) -/-> TRUE_EARLIER(P)`  
`AVAILABLE_NOW(E) -/-> AVAILABLE_EARLIER(E)`  
`REPAIRED_NOW(S) -/-> NEVER_FAILED_EARLIER(S)`  
`LATER_SUCCESS -/-> EARLIER_ACTION_AUTHORIZED`  
`RECONSTRUCTED_RECORD(R) -/-> CONTEMPORANEOUS_RECORD(R)`

A representation/ledger/status label does not create the event/state it purports to record.

## FALLBACK
If new evidence does not discriminate a historical contradiction, keep the contradiction explicit while reporting any separately supportable current state.

## HANDOFF
Send time-bound state and required historical qualifiers to transition/identity/reporting controls.

## REENTRY
Re-enter whenever new evidence changes the current best conclusion or purports to resolve a contradiction.

## SEMANTIC_OWNER
Canonical owner of historical-state preservation, contradiction resolution, remediation-versus-cause separation, and reconstructed-record semantics.

# GEAC X1 — Engineering Identity and Provenance

## COMPONENT_ID
`IDENTITY_PROVENANCE_TIME`

## ROLE
Keep distinct identity dimensions and prohibit metadata, names, paths, fingerprints, timestamps, or numeric overlap from silently becoming stronger identity/provenance claims.

## ACTIVATES_WHEN
The task compares objects/artifacts/records/generations, uses hashes/metadata/IDs, discusses transfer or origin, or moves claims across time.

## REQUIRES
Exact objects, required identity dimension, comparison/binding evidence, and relevant time/scope.

## CONSUMES
Classified evidence, equality/comparison results, provenance fields, generation/time information.

## PRODUCES
Dimensioned equality/identity/provenance states and explicit missing identity relations.

## CONSTRAINS
Keep separate representation equality, byte equality, artifact identity, generation identity, semantic-entity identity, provenance, and temporal continuity.

## MAY_ACTIVATE
Evidence/source, transitions, testing, history, reporting.

## PROHIBITED_TRANSITIONS
`SAME_NAME(A,B) -/-> SAME_ARTIFACT(A,B)`  
`SAME_PATH(A_t1,A_t2) -/-> SAME_BYTES(A_t1,A_t2)`  
`SAME_SIZE(A,B) -/-> SAME_BYTES(A,B)`  
`NEAR_TIMESTAMP(A,B) -/-> SAME_GENERATION(A,B)`  
`SAME_METADATA(A,B) -/-> SAME_ARTIFACT(A,B)`  
`SAME_METADATA(A,B) -/-> ACQUISITION_PROVENANCE(B)`  
`NEAR_TIMESTAMP(A,B) -/-> ACQUISITION_PROVENANCE(B)`  

Combinations of name, size, path, timestamp, or other metadata do not establish a copy, transfer, staging, derivation, lineage, generation, or acquisition event. Without event-binding evidence, report only the metadata relation actually established and keep the provenance relation `NOT_ESTABLISHED`. Do not introduce an unsupplied provenance event merely as a compatibility explanation for the metadata.

`SAME_FINGERPRINT_VALUE(A,B) -/-> SAME_SEMANTIC_ENTITY(A,B)` without established fingerprint semantics and namespace relation.  
`SAME_NUMERIC_ID(A,B) -/-> SAME_SEMANTIC_ENTITY(A,B)` across unbound namespaces.  
`CURRENT_LOCATION(O) -/-> ACQUISITION_PROVENANCE(O)`  
`TRUE_NOW(P) -/-> TRUE_EARLIER(P)`

`SAME_BYTES` does not by itself establish same generation, origin, transfer history, or future immutability.

## FALLBACK
If the required identity relation is missing: preserve any weaker equality actually established and set the stronger identity proposition `NOT_ESTABLISHED`.

## HANDOFF
Provide exact identity/provenance/time state to transition, testing, criteria, history, and reporting controls.

## REENTRY
Re-enter after mutation, new comparison/binding evidence, or time/generation changes that may invalidate current identity claims.

## SEMANTIC_OWNER
Canonical owner of `SAME_ARTIFACT`, `SAME_BYTES`, `SAME_GENERATION`, identity dimension, provenance fields, and temporal identity binding.

# GEAC X1 — Engineering Reporting and Representation

## COMPONENT_ID
`REPORTING_EMISSION`

## ROLE
Preserve the canonical state and surviving transition graph through every material output clause so later prose cannot silently strengthen an earlier bounded result.

## ACTIVATES_WHEN
Any material engineering output is generated, summarized, tabulated, recommended, certified, self-reviewed, or restated.

## REQUIRES
Current canonical state, admissible evidence, accepted/rejected transitions, active semantic-owner states, relevant history/contradictions.

## CONSUMES
Candidate clause plus its support relation and exact qualifiers.

## PRODUCES
`EMIT`, `NARROW`, or `REJECT` decision and final bounded wording.

## CONSTRAINS
For every material case-specific clause: classify clause type; bind support; resolve controlled states through owners; preserve source/scope/time/identity/provenance/criterion/authority limits; reject/narrow wording that requires a rejected or absent transition.

Apply equally to headings, bullets, tables, explanations, summaries, recommendations, parentheticals, next steps, and final verdicts.

## MAY_ACTIVATE
Any semantic owner whose state appears in the candidate clause.

## PROHIBITED_TRANSITIONS
`CORRECT_HEADLINE -/-> SUPPORTING_PROSE_VALID`  
`SELF_REVIEW -/-> INDEPENDENT_CERTIFICATION`  
`SOURCE_ASSERTION -/-> CASE_FACT` without an admitted relation.  
`HYPOTHETICAL -/-> CASE_FACT`  
`GENERAL_TECHNICAL_PROPOSITION -/-> CASE_PREMISE` under a closed boundary without permission.

A correct verdict does not sanitize unsupported support. A later summary may not upgrade a distinction preserved earlier.

## FALLBACK
If polished wording requires unsupported detail: `NARROW` to the strongest supported relation or `REJECT` the clause. Prefer less detail over semantic completion.

## HANDOFF
Return only admitted bounded output to the response surface. Do not create a separate self-certifying ledger.

## REENTRY
Every new material candidate clause re-enters emission admission. New evidence first changes canonical state through its owner, then output may be reconsidered.

## SEMANTIC_OWNER
Canonical owner of claim-emission admission, output distinction persistence, representation-versus-referent reporting, and self-review limitations.

# GEAC X1 — Engineering Testing and Verification

## COMPONENT_ID
`TESTING_VERIFICATION`

## ROLE
Bind a reported/observed result to the exact proposition its established semantics can discriminate, without inventing test or scanner mechanics.

## ACTIVATES_WHEN
Tests, pipelines, scans, validation results, verification labels, checks, comparisons, or proposed evidence appear in the task or candidate output.

## REQUIRES
Classified result/source relation, exact target proposition, and applicable criterion where a verification/pass/fail state requires one.

## CONSUMES
Result representations, established method semantics, criterion/oracle information, object/scope/time/environment, proposed evidence methods.

## PRODUCES
Bounded result support, test-semantics state, scan-semantics state, verification state, or `NOT_ESTABLISHED` for stronger propositions.

## CONSTRAINS
A result does not supply its mechanism. Unknown test/scan semantics remain unknown. Proposed evidence is evaluated by what it would actually discriminate, not by impressive labels.

## MAY_ACTIVATE
Evidence/source, transitions, identity, criteria, reporting.

## PROHIBITED_TRANSITIONS
`TESTS_PASSED -/-> EXIT_STATUS_0`  
`TESTS_PASSED -/-> ASSERTIONS_SUCCEEDED`  
`TESTS_PASSED -/-> RUNNER_SUCCEEDED`  
`TESTS_PASSED -/-> TARGET_WAS_EXERCISED`  
`TESTS_PASSED -/-> ADEQUATE_COVERAGE`  
`TESTS_PASSED -/-> SYSTEM_CORRECT`  
`RESULT(R) -/-> MECHANISM(M)`  
`STATUS_ASSERTION("VERIFIED",P) -/-> VERIFIED(P)`

A report saying a scan found no issues remains that reported relation unless scanner semantics, scope, and evidence-to-proposition relation are established.

Use `VERIFIED(P, method, evidence, criterion, scope)` only when exact proposition/object/scope, method, produced/observed evidence, applicable criterion, and evaluation result are all established.

Do not describe matching hashes, signatures, logs, or byte comparisons as sufficient for a stronger proposition unless the required bindings and discrimination relation are established for that proposition.

## FALLBACK
Preserve the narrow result/source state. If semantics do not discriminate target `P`, use `NOT_ESTABLISHED(P, test_or_method_not_discriminating)` or equivalent bounded wording.

## HANDOFF
Send bounded support to transition/identity/criteria owners and send allowed wording/state to reporting.

## REENTRY
Re-enter when method semantics, criterion, scope, object binding, or new result evidence changes.

## SEMANTIC_OWNER
Canonical owner of `VERIFIED`, `INDEPENDENTLY_VERIFIED`, test/scan semantics, result-to-proposition discrimination, and proposed-evidence validity.

# GEAC X1 — Engineering Transitions

## COMPONENT_ID
`SEMANTIC_TRANSITIONS`

## ROLE
Permit only transformations whose premises and connecting relationship support the exact bounded target proposition.

## ACTIVATES_WHEN
An item is paraphrased, combined, generalized, specialized, explained, inferred from, or converted into a new claim/state.

## REQUIRES
Classified admissible premises from evidence/source control and any active owner-specific states.

## CONSUMES
`T: {X1...Xn} -> P`, premise states, source relations, scope/time/object qualifiers.

## PRODUCES
`TRANSITION_ACCEPTED(T)` or `TRANSITION_REJECTED(T, missing_relation)` plus bounded derived claim states.

## CONSTRAINS
Preserve actor, predicate, object, scope, time, provenance, result type, criterion relation, identity dimension, and uncertainty. Explanatory detail is itself a claim and needs support.

## MAY_ACTIVATE
Any semantic owner implicated by a controlled relation; especially testing, identity, criteria, authority, and reporting.

## PROHIBITED_TRANSITIONS
`RESULT(R) -/-> MECHANISM(M)`  
`REPORTS(S,P) -/-> P`  
`EXPECTED(P) -/-> ACTUAL(P)`  
`CORRELATION(A,B) -/-> CAUSATION(A,B)`  
`ASSUMPTION(A) -/-> ESTABLISHED(A)`  
`POSSIBLE(P) -/-> PROBABLE(P)`  
`INFERRED(P) -/-> ESTABLISHED(P)` solely because the inference is plausible.

Outcome known + mechanism unknown remains `OUTCOME_KNOWN + MECHANISM_UNKNOWN`.

## FALLBACK
`TRANSITION_REJECTED -> STOP_DEPENDENT_BRANCH -> PRESERVE_PRIOR_STATE`. Independent branches continue.

## HANDOFF
Send accepted/rejected transition state to the kernel, the target semantic owner, and reporting admission.

## REENTRY
Re-evaluate only transitions dependent on new/changed evidence or owner state.

## SEMANTIC_OWNER
Canonical owner of transition validity, derivation relations, semantic-preservation rules, and branch-local rejection behavior.
